# foley

> Unified facade for sourcing, indexing, and searching sound effects to weave into narration


## Pages in this subsection

- [foley](foley.html.md): foley — a retrieval-first façade for sound effects.
- [foley.repair](foley.repair.html.md): Repair instead of quarantine: the fixes a Tier-0 QC report suggests, applied and re-checked (#107).
- [foley.audio](foley.audio.html.md): Audio I/O and DSP primitives for foley.
- [foley.index](foley.index.html.md): foley INDEX stage — make every sound findable by keyword &#42;and&#42; meaning.
- [foley.index.taxonomy](foley.index.taxonomy.html.md): UCS + AudioSet taxonomy: the &#96;tags -&gt; UCS CatID&#96; resolver for foley.
- [foley.index.taxonomy.audioset](foley.index.taxonomy.audioset.html.md): AudioSet-label -&gt; UCS-CatID overlap map (report 04 §5.3, &#91;11 §3.1&#93;).
- [foley.index.taxonomy.model](foley.index.taxonomy.model.html.md): Data structures for the UCS/AudioSet taxonomy resolver (stdlib-only).
- [foley.index.taxonomy.resolver](foley.index.taxonomy.resolver.html.md): Resolve free tags/caption/labels to a UCS CatID (the EnvSound-UCS pipeline).
- [foley.index.taxonomy.seed](foley.index.taxonomy.seed.html.md): Seed taxonomy data — a representative in-code UCS subset + AudioSet overlap map.
- [foley.index.taxonomy.ucs](foley.index.taxonomy.ucs.html.md): UCS table loading + the UCS-filename CatID parse (report 04 §5.2, §6.4).
- [foley.index.embedders](foley.index.embedders.html.md): Embedders — the joint text&lt;-&gt;audio space that powers retrieval.
- [foley.index.indexes](foley.index.indexes.html.md): Concrete vector + keyword index backends (the swappable retrieval engines).
- [foley.index.ingest](foley.index.ingest.html.md): The ingestion pipeline — turn any audio file into a searchable SoundRecord.
- [foley.index.library](foley.index.library.html.md): The &#96;SoundLibrary&#96; façade — one searchable, license-aware sound library.
- [foley.index.onnx_clap](foley.index.onnx_clap.html.md): CLAP on a small host: the same checkpoint through ONNX Runtime, no torch, no transformers.
- [foley.index.protocols](foley.index.protocols.html.md): Structural contracts for the foley index (the retrieval boundary).
- [foley.index.search](foley.index.search.html.md): Hybrid retrieval: reciprocal rank fusion over a vector list and a keyword list.
- [foley.index.taggers](foley.index.taggers.html.md): Taggers — auto-fill a sound’s semantic labels on ingest (report 03).
- [foley.obs](foley.obs.html.md): Observability &amp; the reproducible run-artifact for foley (#11).
- [foley.obs.recorder](foley.obs.recorder.html.md): The run-recorder: owns the manifest, drives the OTel mirror, off by default (#11).
- [foley.obs.redact](foley.obs.redact.html.md): Redaction of sensitive narration / prompt / query text in telemetry (#11).
- [foley.obs.run_artifact](foley.obs.run_artifact.html.md): The reproducible run-artifact SSOT — &#96;RunManifest&#96; + &#96;SpanRecord&#96; (#11).
- [foley.obs.trace](foley.obs.trace.html.md): The OpenTelemetry MIRROR seam for foley’s observability (#11).
- [foley.agent](foley.agent.html.md): The SELECT stage — the search-agent that finds the right sound for a context (#7).
- [foley.agent.decompose](foley.agent.decompose.html.md): &#96;decompose_context&#96; — narrative passage → a sparse, salience-ranked event list.
- [foley.agent.llm](foley.agent.llm.html.md): Which LLM the SELECT rungs use — one explicit, spend-safe resolver (the &#96;llm=&#96; seam).
- [foley.agent.local_llm](foley.agent.local_llm.html.md): Offline / local-LLM SELECT rungs — OpenAI-compatible &#96;Decomposer&#96; / &#96;Judge&#96; / &#96;Refiner&#96;.
- [foley.agent.mcp](foley.agent.mcp.html.md): The MCP surface — foley’s façade as agent-callable tools (py2mcp, #12, report 05/10).
- [foley.agent.policy](foley.agent.policy.html.md): The SELECT policy: the fail-closed rights gate + the single generate-vs-retrieve branch.
- [foley.agent.preview](foley.agent.preview.html.md): Audition UX — preview a sound, find similar ones, and refine by relevance feedback (#12).
- [foley.agent.protocols](foley.agent.protocols.html.md): The structural DI seams of the SELECT stage — &#96;Decomposer&#96; / &#96;Judge&#96; / &#96;Refiner&#96;.
- [foley.agent.refine](foley.agent.refine.html.md): &#96;refine_query&#96; — one event query → 2–4 paraphrases for multi-query retrieval.
- [foley.agent.session](foley.agent.session.html.md): Session-scoped audition state — cached candidates, picks, and rejects (#12).
- [foley.agent.tools](foley.agent.tools.html.md): The SELECT orchestration: &#96;find()&#96; / &#96;plan()&#96; + the small pure tool wrappers.
- [foley.agent.verify](foley.agent.verify.html.md): &#96;verify_match&#96; — the retrieve→verify ladder (clap → listen → judge) + &#96;Judge&#96; impls.
- [foley.weave](foley.weave.html.md): WEAVE — the compositor façade: narration + timeline → a finished, editable mix.
- [foley.weave.align](foley.weave.align.html.md): Forced-alignment adapters — the &#96;Aligner&#96; seam’s fake default + WhisperX real impl.
- [foley.weave.anchor](foley.weave.anchor.html.md): Symbolic-anchor → sample-onset heuristics — the SELECT→WEAVE timing bridge (report 06 §2.4).
- [foley.weave.master](foley.weave.master.html.md): Mastering — loudness-normalize + true-peak-limit the finished mix (report 06 §5).
- [foley.weave.mix](foley.weave.mix.html.md): Pure-numpy mixing DSP — making a clip sit under the voice (report 06 §3).
- [foley.weave.protocols](foley.weave.protocols.html.md): The structural DI seams of the WEAVE stage — &#96;Aligner&#96; / &#96;ApplyStrategy&#96;.
- [foley.weave.reaction](foley.weave.reaction.html.md): Audience-reaction timing — a crowd answers an event, it does not coincide with it.
- [foley.weave.requirements](foley.weave.requirements.html.md): System-dependency onboarding for WEAVE’s optional upgrade paths (accompy-style).
- [foley.weave.timeline](foley.weave.timeline.html.md): The sound-design timeline as an editable document — hydrate, edit, caption.
- [foley.eval](foley.eval.html.md): Tier-1 retrieval evaluation — metrics, a frozen golden set, and the nDCG gate.
- [foley.eval.baseline](foley.eval.baseline.html.md): The committed nDCG baseline — the PR gate’s SSOT + staleness stamps.
- [foley.eval.embedder](foley.eval.embedder.html.md): A deterministic, numpy-only text embedder for the retrieval eval gate.
- [foley.eval.fidelity](foley.eval.fidelity.html.md): Set-level generation-fidelity — Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) + Kernel Audio Distance (KAD).
- [foley.eval.fit](foley.eval.fit.html.md): Tier-2 fit evaluation — “does the accepted clip actually match the intent?” (report 08 §2/§5).
- [foley.eval.golden](foley.eval.golden.html.md): The frozen golden set + the deterministic Ring-0 retrieval harness.
- [foley.eval.prompt_match](foley.eval.prompt_match.html.md): Calibrate the prompt-match threshold of a text-audio embedder on a labelled set (#111).
- [foley.eval.reliability](foley.eval.reliability.html.md): Inter-rater reliability — Krippendorff’s α + the judge-vs-human calibration guardrail.
- [foley.eval.retrieval](foley.eval.retrieval.html.md): Tier-1 retrieval metrics + run assembly — pure stdlib, CI-safe, ranx-exact.
- [foley.provenance](foley.provenance.html.md): Provenance layer for foley — attribution/credits (and, later, disclosure).
- [foley.provenance.credits](foley.provenance.credits.html.md): TASL attribution / credits generator — the provenance render layer (#9a).
- [foley.provenance.disclosure](foley.provenance.disclosure.html.md): Disclosure, watermarking &amp; safety for AI-generated audio (#9b).
- [foley.agent_kit](foley.agent_kit.html.md): Install foley’s shipped agent kit — the consumer skill + Claude slash command + subagent.
- [foley.base](foley.base.html.md): Canonical data models for foley — the single source of truth (SSOT) types.
- [foley.cli](foley.cli.html.md): The &#96;foley&#96; command-line interface (stdlib &#96;argparse&#96;, zero new deps).
- [foley.cost](foley.cost.html.md): Cost: what a call will cost before it is made, and a cumulative cap on a run (#57).
- [foley.level](foley.level.html.md): Level a clip to a stated loudness target for its class, so relative levels are sane.
- [foley.licensing](foley.licensing.html.md): License policy for foley: the license_id -&gt; flag-set SSOT, flag derivation
- [foley.prompt_match](foley.prompt_match.html.md): Does a generated clip sound like what was asked for? A text-audio check, or an honest “unchecked”.
- [foley.qc](foley.qc.html.md): Tier-0 deterministic audio QC for foley (research report 08 §3).
- [foley.requirements](foley.requirements.html.md): Onboarding — check what foley needs, tell the user how to get it (accompy-style, #12).
- [foley.runtime](foley.runtime.html.md): Runtime posture — local-first / offline mode as one verifiable contract (#12, report 12).
- [foley.sources](foley.sources.html.md): Bulk-corpus source adapters for foley’s SOURCE stage.

- [foley.sources.internet_archive.adapter](foley.sources.internet_archive.adapter.html.md): Internet Archive retrieve adapter: opt-in discovery of archival sounds, never auto-verified.
